  <style>
    :root {
      /* === DARK THEME (default) === */
      --bg: #0b0d12;
      --bg-2: #12151d;
      --bg-3: #1a1e28;
      --bg-4: #232836;
      --line: #2a3040;
      --fg: #e6e8ef;
      --muted: #8b93a7;
      --accent: #7c5cff;
      --accent-2: #22d3ee;
      --ok: #22c55e;
      --warn: #f59e0b;
      --err: #ef4444;
      --radius: 10px;
      /* Surfaces tied to specific patterns (translucent toolbars, masks, etc.) */
      --topbar-bg: rgba(11,13,18,0.85);
      --code-fg: #c9d1d9;
      --mask-bg: rgba(11,13,18,.20);
      --shadow-card: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
      --shadow-modal: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
    }

    /* === LIGHT THEME (opt-in via <html data-theme="light">) === */
    :root[data-theme="light"] {
      --bg: #f5f6fa;
      --bg-2: #ffffff;
      --bg-3: #eef0f6;
      --bg-4: #e1e5ee;
      --line: #d5dae3;
      --fg: #1a1d28;
      --muted: #5b6478;
      --accent: #6747e0;
      --accent-2: #0891b2;
      --ok: #16a34a;
      --warn: #d97706;
      --err: #dc2626;
      --topbar-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.88);
      --code-fg: #1a1d28;
      --mask-bg: rgba(15,18,28,.18);
      --shadow-card: 0 4px 14px rgba(15,18,28,.08);
      --shadow-modal: 0 30px 80px rgba(15,18,28,.18);
    }
    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--fg); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; }
    code, pre, textarea, .mono, .CodeMirror { font-family: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; }
    a { color: var(--accent-2); }

    /* Top Bar */
    .topbar {
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      background: var(--topbar-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
    .logo-badge { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2)); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: #0b0d12; letter-spacing: -0.5px; }
    .topbar .spacer { flex: 1; }
    .statusbar {
      position: sticky; top: 49px; z-index: 49;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;
      padding: 5px 20px;
      background: var(--topbar-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    }
    .chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 9px; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
    .chip .dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--muted); flex-shrink: 0; }
    .chip.ok .dot { background: var(--ok); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(34,197,94,.15); }
    .chip.warn .dot { background: var(--warn); }
    .chip.err .dot { background: var(--err); }
    .chip.loading .dot { background: var(--accent-2); animation: pulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
    @keyframes pulse { 0%,100% { opacity: .4; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }

    /* Tabs */
    .tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 20px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg); position: sticky; top: 85px; z-index: 40; }
    .tab { padding: 10px 16px; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid transparent; border-bottom: none; }
    .tab:hover { color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg-2); }
    .tab.active { background: var(--bg-2); color: var(--fg); border-color: var(--line); margin-bottom: -1px; }

    /* Main Layout */
    .main { padding: 20px; max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; }
    .panel { display: none; }
    .panel.active { display: block; }

    /* Cards / Grid */
    .grid-2 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px; }
    /* Resizable generate split */
    .gen-split { display: flex; gap: 0; align-items: stretch; min-height: 0; }
    .gen-split > .card { min-width: 180px; overflow: auto; }
    .gen-split > .card:first-child { flex: 0 0 var(--gen-left-pct, 50%); }
    .gen-split > .card:last-child  { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 220px; }
    .gen-divider {
      flex: 0 0 8px; cursor: col-resize; z-index: 1;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      background: transparent; transition: background 120ms;
      position: relative;
    }
    .gen-divider::after {
      content: ''; display: block;
      width: 3px; height: 48px; border-radius: 3px;
      background: var(--line); transition: background 120ms, height 120ms;
    }
    .gen-divider:hover::after,
    .gen-divider.dragging::after { background: var(--accent); height: 64px; }
    @media (max-width: 900px) {
      .gen-split { flex-direction: column; }
      .gen-split > .card:first-child { flex: none; width: 100%; }
      .gen-divider { display: none; }
    }
    .grid-3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 14px; }
    @media (max-width: 900px) { .grid-2, .grid-3 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .card { background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 18px; }
    .card h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .card h2 .num { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bg-4); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
    .card p.hint { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; margin: 0 0 12px; line-height: 1.5; }

    /* Inputs */
    label { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin: 10px 0 4px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
    input, select, textarea { width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--fg); font-size: 13px; outline: none; transition: border-color 120ms; }
    input:focus, select:focus, textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
    textarea { min-height: 100px; resize: vertical; line-height: 1.5; }

    /* Buttons */
    .row { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
    button { padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg-3); color: var(--fg); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 120ms; }
    button:hover { background: var(--bg-4); }
    button:disabled { opacity: .4; cursor: not-allowed; }
    button.primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), #5b3ef2); border: none; color: white; }
    button.primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.15); }
    button.ghost { background: transparent; }
    button.danger { color: var(--err); border-color: rgba(239,68,68,.25); }
    button.danger:hover { background: rgba(239,68,68,.1); }
    button.tiny { padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px; }

    /* Code editor */
    .CodeMirror { height: 480px !important; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 13px; }
    .CodeMirror-scroll { max-height: 480px; }

    /* Output */
    pre.out { background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; overflow: auto; font-size: 12.5px; max-height: 320px; color: var(--code-fg); white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word; }

    /* Pyodide progress */
    .progress { height: 6px; background: var(--bg-4); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; margin-top: 8px; }
    .progress .bar { height: 100%; width: 0%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2)); transition: width 300ms; }

    /* Tool cards */
    .tool-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; }
    .tool-card { background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; transition: opacity 150ms, border-color 150ms; }
    .tool-card.disabled { opacity: .55; }
    .tool-card .tool-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .tool-card .name { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 13px; color: var(--accent-2); flex: 1; }
    .tool-card .desc { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 10px; min-height: 32px; line-height: 1.4; }
    .tool-card .stats { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 6px 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.02); border-radius: 6px; }
    .tool-card .actions { display: flex; gap: 5px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .tool-card .badge { font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: .03em; }
    .badge-cold { background: rgba(139,147,167,.15); color: var(--muted); }
    .badge-warm { background: rgba(34,197,94,.15); color: #86efac; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(34,197,94,.25); }
    .badge-rt { background: rgba(124,92,255,.12); color: #c4b5fd; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0; }
    .badge-net { background: rgba(34,211,238,.14); color: #a5f3fc; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(34,211,238,.25); }

    /* Toggle switch */
    .toggle { position: relative; display: inline-block; width: 32px; height: 18px; cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .toggle input { opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; }
    .toggle-slider { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--bg-4); border-radius: 999px; transition: 150ms; }
    .toggle-slider::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 2px; top: 2px; width: 14px; height: 14px; background: var(--muted); border-radius: 50%; transition: 150ms; }
    .toggle input:checked + .toggle-slider { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2)); }
    .toggle input:checked + .toggle-slider::before { transform: translateX(14px); background: white; }

    /* No-key banner */
    .banner {
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap;
      padding: 14px 18px; border-radius: var(--radius); margin-bottom: 16px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,92,255,.15), rgba(34,211,238,.08));
      border: 1px solid rgba(124,92,255,.35);
    }
    .banner-title { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 2px; }
    .banner-sub { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); }
    .banner select { min-width: 220px; max-width: 320px; }

    .btn-like { display: inline-block; padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg-3); color: var(--fg); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; }
    .btn-like:hover { background: var(--bg-4); }

    /* Segmented control */
    .segmented { display: inline-flex; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 3px; gap: 2px; }
    .segmented button { background: transparent; border: none; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }
    .segmented button.active { background: var(--bg-4); color: var(--fg); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--line); }
    .segmented button:hover { color: var(--fg); }

    /* JIT log styles */
    .mcp-entry.jit { border-left-color: #fbbf24; background: rgba(251,191,36,.04); }
    .mcp-entry.jit.cold { border-left-color: #f59e0b; background: rgba(245,158,11,.06); }
    .mcp-entry.jit.cold .head { color: #fbbf24; }
    .mcp-entry.jit.warm { border-left-color: #22c55e; background: rgba(34,197,94,.04); }
    .mcp-entry.jit.warm .head { color: #86efac; }
    .mcp-entry.jit.err { border-left-color: var(--err); }

    /* Tool palette (chat) */
    .palette-bar { background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; margin: 10px 0 12px; }
    .palette-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--muted); }
    .palette { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; min-height: 24px; }
    .palette .tchip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 10px 5px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--bg-2); border-radius: 999px; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; color: var(--muted); transition: all 120ms; }
    .palette .tchip:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--fg); }
    .palette .tchip.on { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,92,255,.18), rgba(34,211,238,.12)); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--fg); }
    .palette .tchip.on .tdot { background: var(--ok); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(34,197,94,.2); }
    .palette .tchip.warm .tdot { background: #fbbf24; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(251,191,36,.2); }
    .palette .tchip .tdot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--muted); }
    .palette .empty { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-style: italic; padding: 2px 0; }

    /* Chat */
    .chat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; max-height: 480px; overflow-y: auto; padding: 6px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); min-height: 300px; }
    .msg { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; max-width: 85%; }
    .msg.user { background: var(--accent); color: white; align-self: flex-end; }
    .msg.assistant { background: var(--bg-4); align-self: flex-start; }
    .msg.tool { background: rgba(34,211,238,.08); border: 1px solid rgba(34,211,238,.3); align-self: flex-start; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #a5f3fc; white-space: pre-wrap; }
    .msg.system { background: transparent; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; text-align: center; align-self: center; }
    .msg .role { font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: .7; margin-bottom: 4px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
    .msg.streaming .cursor { display: inline-block; margin-left: 2px; opacity: .8; animation: blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }
    @keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }
    .msg .body { white-space: pre-wrap; }

    /* MCP Console */
    .mcp-log { max-height: 460px; overflow-y: auto; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; }
    .mcp-entry { padding: 8px 10px; margin-bottom: 6px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-2); border-left: 3px solid var(--accent); }
    .mcp-entry.out { border-left-color: var(--accent-2); }
    .mcp-entry .head { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 4px; }
    .mcp-entry pre { margin: 0; white-space: pre-wrap; color: var(--code-fg); }

    /* Examples */
    .example-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; margin-top: 10px; }
    .example { padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 120ms; font-size: 12.5px; }
    .example:hover { border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .example .ex-title { font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 3px; }
    .example .ex-desc { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11.5px; }
    .example .ex-host { color: var(--accent-2); font-size: 10.5px; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; margin-top: 4px; }
    .example .try-btn { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 11px; padding: 3px 0; }

    /* Key visibility toggle */
    .input-wrap { position: relative; }
    .input-wrap button.eye { position: absolute; right: 6px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px; background: transparent; border: none; color: var(--muted); }

    .notice { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12.5px; margin: 10px 0; }
    .notice.warn { background: rgba(245,158,11,.1); border: 1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.3); color: #fcd34d; }
    .notice.ok   { background: rgba(34,197,94,.08); border: 1px solid rgba(34,197,94,.25); color: #86efac; }
    .notice.err  { background: rgba(239,68,68,.1); border: 1px solid rgba(239,68,68,.3); color: #fca5a5; }

    .kbd { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 6px; background: var(--bg-4); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11px; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color: var(--muted); }
    .flex-between { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; }
    .counter { background: var(--bg-4); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
    details > summary { cursor: pointer; padding: 6px 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }

    /* ============================================================
       AGENTS TAB — agentic layer + service graph
       ============================================================ */
    .tab-pill { display:inline-block; min-width:18px; padding:1px 6px; margin-left:6px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--bg-4); color:var(--muted); font-size:10px; font-weight:600; text-align:center; vertical-align:middle; }
    .tab.active .tab-pill { background: var(--accent); color: white; }

    /* Strategy selector */
    .strategy-rail { display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    @media (max-width: 1280px) { .strategy-rail { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); } }
    @media (max-width: 1100px) { .strategy-rail { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } }
    @media (max-width: 720px)  { .strategy-rail { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
    .strategy-card { position:relative; padding: 12px 14px; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; user-select:none; }
    .strategy-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .strategy-card.active { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,92,255,.16), rgba(34,211,238,.08)); border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent); }
    .strategy-card .s-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 4px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
    .strategy-card .s-icon { font-size: 14px; }
    .strategy-card .s-desc { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.4; }
    .strategy-card .s-topology { display:block; font-family: ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace; font-size: 10px; color: var(--accent-2); margin-top: 6px; opacity: .8; }

    /* 3-column layout: palette | canvas | inspector */
    .agents-layout { display:grid; grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr 280px; gap: 14px; }
    @media (max-width: 1100px) { .agents-layout { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .agents-col { background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; }
    .agents-col h3 { font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 10px; font-weight: 600; }

    /* Tools palette (drag source) */
    .tool-palette { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-height: 540px; overflow-y: auto; }
    .draggable-tool { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; cursor: grab; transition: all 120ms; user-select: none; }
    .draggable-tool:hover { border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--bg-4); }
    .draggable-tool:active, .draggable-tool.dragging { cursor: grabbing; opacity: .55; }
    .draggable-tool .dt-name { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--accent-2); flex: 1; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
    .draggable-tool .dt-rt { font-size: 9px; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(124,92,255,.15); color: #c4b5fd; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; }
    .draggable-tool.persona-tool { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,211,238,.10), rgba(124,92,255,.06)); border-color: rgba(34,211,238,.4); }
    .palette-empty { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-style: italic; padding: 14px 4px; text-align: center; }
    .palette-search { width:100%; margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 6px 8px; font-size: 12px; }

    /* Service graph canvas */
    .agents-canvas-wrap { position: relative; }
    .agents-toolbar { display:flex; gap:6px; align-items:center; margin-bottom:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
    .agents-toolbar .spacer { flex:1; }
    .topology-hint { padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; margin-bottom: 10px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; }
    .topology-hint .topology-name { color: var(--accent-2); font-weight: 600; }
    .service-graph { position: relative; height: 540px; background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(255,255,255,.04) 1px, transparent 0) 0 0 / 24px 24px,
        var(--bg-3);
      border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; }
    .service-graph svg { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
    .service-graph svg .edge { stroke: rgba(124,92,255,.5); stroke-width: 1.6; fill: none; }
    .service-graph svg .edge.tool { stroke: rgba(34,211,238,.45); stroke-dasharray: 4 4; }
    .service-graph svg .edge.flow { stroke: rgba(124,92,255,.85); stroke-width: 2; marker-end: url(#arrow); }
    .service-graph svg .edge.flow-dim { stroke: rgba(124,92,255,.25); stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-dasharray: 2 5; marker-end: url(#arrow-dim); }
    .service-graph svg .edge.handoff { stroke: rgba(245,158,11,.45); stroke-width: 1.4; stroke-dasharray: 6 4; }
    .service-graph svg text.edge-label { fill: var(--muted); font-size: 10px; font-family: ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace; }

    .graph-node { position: absolute; min-width: 160px; max-width: 220px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--bg-2); border: 1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; cursor: grab; user-select: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35); transition: border-color 120ms, transform 120ms, box-shadow 120ms; }
    .graph-node:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
    .graph-node.selected { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(124,92,255,.4), 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.4); }
    .graph-node.dragging { cursor: grabbing; transform: scale(1.02); z-index: 10; }
    .graph-node.drag-over { border-color: var(--ok); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(34,197,94,.45); background: rgba(34,197,94,.08); }
    .graph-node .gn-head { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .graph-node .gn-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink:0; }
    .graph-node .gn-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; flex:1; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; }
    .graph-node .gn-role { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.3; max-height: 30px; overflow:hidden; }
    .graph-node .gn-tools { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:4px; }
    .graph-node .gn-tool { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 10px; padding: 2px 6px; background: rgba(34,211,238,.10); border: 1px solid rgba(34,211,238,.3); color: #a5f3fc; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; }
    .graph-node .gn-tool:hover { background: rgba(239,68,68,.15); border-color: rgba(239,68,68,.4); color: #fca5a5; }
    .graph-node .gn-tools-empty { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--muted); font-style: italic; padding: 2px; }
    .graph-node .gn-badge { position:absolute; top:-7px; right:8px; background: var(--accent); color: white; font-size: 9px; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .04em; }
    .graph-node.system-node { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,92,255,.18), rgba(34,211,238,.08)); border-style: dashed; border-color: rgba(124,92,255,.5); }
    .graph-node.system-node .gn-name { color: #c4b5fd; }
    .graph-node.persona-node { border-left-width: 4px; }

    /* Inspector */
    .inspector { font-size: 13px; }
    .inspector .insp-empty { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-style: italic; padding: 20px 4px; text-align:center; }
    .inspector .insp-row { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding: 6px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 12px; }
    .inspector .insp-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
    .inspector .insp-row .k { color: var(--muted); }
    .inspector .insp-row .v { color: var(--fg); font-family: ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace; font-size: 11.5px; }
    .inspector textarea, .inspector input, .inspector select { font-size: 12px; }

    /* Modal */
    .modal-backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,.7); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); z-index: 100; display:none; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
    .modal-backdrop.open { display:flex; }
    .modal { background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; width: 540px; max-width: 92vw; max-height: 88vh; overflow-y: auto; box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.5); }
    .modal h2 { margin-top: 0; font-size: 16px; }
    .modal .row { margin-top: 14px; }
    .color-grid { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:6px; margin-top: 4px; }
    .color-chip { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; border: 2px solid transparent; transition: transform 120ms; }
    .color-chip.selected { border-color: var(--fg); transform: scale(1.1); }

    /* Agentic mode bar in chat */
    .agentic-bar { padding: 10px 12px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,92,255,.10), rgba(34,211,238,.05)); border: 1px solid rgba(124,92,255,.35); border-radius: 8px; margin: 0 0 10px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap: wrap; font-size: 12.5px; }
    .agentic-bar .ab-label { color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; }
    .agentic-bar select { width: auto; min-width: 180px; padding: 5px 8px; font-size: 12px; }
    .msg.persona { background: rgba(124,92,255,.12); border: 1px solid rgba(124,92,255,.35); align-self: flex-start; font-size: 12.5px; color: #c4b5fd; }
    .msg.persona .role { color: var(--accent); }

    /* ============================================================
       ONBOARDING MODAL — first-run welcome
       ============================================================ */
    .onb-backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 200; display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: rgba(0,0,0,.30); padding: 20px; }
    .onb-backdrop.open { display: flex; }
    .onb-modal { background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; padding: 28px; max-width: 760px; width: 100%; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.6); }
    .onb-modal h1 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.02em; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2)); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent; }
    .onb-modal .onb-sub { color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 22px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }
    .onb-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 12px; }
    @media (max-width: 760px) { .onb-cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
    .onb-card { padding: 18px; background: var(--bg-3); border: 2px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; position: relative; }
    .onb-card:hover { border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(124,92,255,.2); }
    .onb-card.recommended { border-color: rgba(34,197,94,.5); background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,197,94,.08), rgba(34,211,238,.04)); }
    .onb-card.recommended::before { content: "RECOMMENDED"; position: absolute; top: -10px; right: 12px; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--ok); color: white; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .05em; border-radius: 4px; }
    .onb-card .onb-icon { font-size: 32px; line-height: 1; }
    .onb-card .onb-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; margin-top: 4px; }
    .onb-card .onb-meta { font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent-2); font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; }
    .onb-card .onb-desc { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.4; }
    .onb-card.disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }
    .onb-bottom { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: 22px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .onb-bottom .onb-tour-prompt { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
    .onb-progress { display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 14px; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; margin-top: 16px; }
    .onb-progress.active { display: flex; }
    .onb-progress .onb-progress-msg { font-size: 13px; color: var(--accent-2); font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; }

    /* ============================================================
       INTERACTIVE TUTORIAL — pulsing highlights + tooltips
       ============================================================
       Approach: instead of a single full-screen backdrop (which blurs the target too),
       we render FOUR mask rects that wrap around the highlight area on all sides.
       The highlight rect itself has no overlay — content stays fully crisp. */
    .tut-backdrop { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 9998; background: var(--mask-bg); display: none; pointer-events: none; }
    .tut-backdrop.active { display: block; }

    .tut-mask {
      position: fixed; z-index: 9998; pointer-events: none;
      background: var(--mask-bg);
      /* No backdrop-filter — blur on 4 simultaneous fixed elements kills framerate */
      display: none;
      will-change: top, left, width, height;
    }
    .tut-mask.active { display: block; }

    /* The target itself gets nothing rendered over it — only this ring floats above. */
    .tut-highlight {
      position: fixed; z-index: 9999; pointer-events: none;
      border-radius: 12px;
      outline: 3px solid rgba(124,92,255,.95);
      box-shadow: 0 0 22px 4px rgba(124,92,255,.5);
      /* opacity animation is GPU-composited (no repaint), unlike box-shadow */
      animation: tut-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
      will-change: opacity, top, left, width, height;
    }
    @keyframes tut-pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
      50%       { opacity: 0.65; }
    }

    .tut-tooltip {
      position: fixed; z-index: 10000; max-width: 360px;
      background: var(--bg-2); border: 1.5px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 16px 18px; box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.6);
      will-change: top, left;
    }
    .tut-tooltip .tut-step { font-size: 11px; color: var(--accent-2); font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; margin-bottom: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; }
    .tut-tooltip h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; }
    .tut-tooltip .tut-body { color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 14px; }
    .tut-tooltip .tut-body strong { color: var(--fg); }
    .tut-tooltip .tut-body code { background: var(--bg-3); padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 11.5px; }
    .tut-tooltip .tut-controls { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; }
    .tut-tooltip .tut-controls .spacer { flex: 1; }
    .tut-tooltip .tut-skip { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); background: transparent; border: none; padding: 4px 6px; cursor: pointer; }
    .tut-tooltip .tut-skip:hover { color: var(--err); }
    .tut-tooltip .tut-arrow { position: absolute; width: 10px; height: 10px; background: var(--bg-2); border: 1.5px solid var(--accent); transform: rotate(45deg); }

    /* Topbar icon buttons (theme toggle, help) */
    .icon-btn { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; padding: 0; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center; transition: all 150ms; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .icon-btn:hover { color: var(--fg); border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--bg-4); }
    .icon-btn svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; }
    .share-dropdown { position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .share-trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 0 10px; height: 28px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms; white-space: nowrap; }
    .share-trigger svg { width: 13px; height: 13px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .share-trigger:hover, .share-dropdown.open .share-trigger { color: var(--fg); border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--bg-4); }
    .share-menu { display: none; position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 6px); right: 0; background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 5px; min-width: 150px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4); z-index: 999; }
    .share-dropdown.open .share-menu { display: block; }
    .share-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 7px; text-decoration: none; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; transition: all 120ms; }
    .share-item svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .share-item:hover { background: var(--bg-3); }
    .share-fb:hover { color: #1877f2; }
    .share-x:hover { color: #e7e7e7; }
    .share-li:hover { color: #0a66c2; }
    /* Show only the icon that matches the current theme */
    .theme-toggle .icon-light { display: none; }
    .theme-toggle .icon-dark  { display: block; }
    :root[data-theme="light"] .theme-toggle .icon-light { display: block; }
    :root[data-theme="light"] .theme-toggle .icon-dark  { display: none; }
    /* Help button (legacy class — keeps backward compat) */
    .help-btn { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; padding: 0; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; display: grid; place-items: center; transition: all 150ms; }
    .help-btn:hover { color: var(--fg); border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--bg-4); }
    .help-btn.attention { animation: help-attention 2s ease-in-out infinite; border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
    @keyframes help-attention {
      0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(124,92,255,.7); }
      50%      { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(124,92,255,0); }
    }
    .help-menu { position: fixed; top: 50px; right: 16px; z-index: 60; background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px; min-width: 240px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.5); display: none; }
    .help-menu.open { display: block; }
    .help-menu .help-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; }
    .help-menu .help-item:hover { background: var(--bg-3); }
    .help-menu .help-item.toggle-row { cursor: default; justify-content: space-between; }
    .help-menu .help-divider { height: 1px; background: var(--line); margin: 4px 0; }

    /* ============================================================
       Powered-by-WebAssembly badge (bottom-right corner)
       ============================================================ */
    .wasm-badge {
      position: fixed; bottom: 14px; right: 14px; z-index: 30;
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
      padding: 6px 11px 6px 7px;
      background: var(--topbar-bg);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted);
      text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
      transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms, transform 150ms, box-shadow 150ms;
      user-select: none;
    }
    .wasm-badge:hover {
      color: var(--fg);
      border-color: #654FF0;
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 22px rgba(101,79,240,.35);
    }
    .wasm-badge svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .wasm-badge .wasm-label { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .01em; }
    .wasm-badge .wasm-label strong { color: #c4b5fd; font-weight: 600; }

    /* ============================================================
       PROJECT PACK — manifest export/import + wizard
       ============================================================ */
    .pack-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 6px; }
    .pack-actions input[type="file"] { display: none; }
    .pack-stat { font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; background: var(--bg-3); border-radius: 6px; font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; }

    /* Connected services list */
    .creds-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-top: 6px; }
    .cred-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; }
    .cred-row .cred-key { font-family: ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; font-size: 12px; color: var(--accent-2); flex: 1; }
    .cred-row .cred-val { font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
    .cred-row .cred-actions { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
    .cred-empty { padding: 14px; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12.5px; font-style: italic; }

    /* Wizard modal */
    .wizard-modal { background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; width: 640px; max-width: 92vw; max-height: 88vh; overflow-y: auto; box-shadow: var(--shadow-modal); }
    .wizard-modal h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 16px; }
    .wizard-modal .wizard-sub { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 16px; }
    .wizard-progress { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0; margin-bottom: 18px; }
    .wizard-progress .wp-step { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; position: relative; }
    .wizard-progress .wp-dot { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1.5px solid var(--line); display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); transition: all 200ms; }
    .wizard-progress .wp-step.active .wp-dot { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: white; }
    .wizard-progress .wp-step.done .wp-dot { background: var(--ok); border-color: var(--ok); color: white; }
    .wizard-progress .wp-label { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .05em; }
    .wizard-progress .wp-step.active .wp-label, .wizard-progress .wp-step.done .wp-label { color: var(--fg); }
    .wizard-progress .wp-line { flex: 1; height: 1.5px; background: var(--line); margin: 0 -8px; align-self: flex-start; margin-top: 11px; }
    .wizard-progress .wp-line.done { background: var(--ok); }
    .wizard-step { display: none; }
    .wizard-step.active { display: block; }

    .pack-summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; margin: 12px 0; }
    .pack-stat-card { padding: 12px; background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; text-align: center; }
    .pack-stat-card .num { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-2); }

        <label style="margin:0;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;"><input type="checkbox" id="onbTakeTour" checked style="width:auto;"> Show me the tour</label>
        <button class="ghost" id="onbCloseBtn">Close</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ===== LLM LOADER MODAL — visible whenever local backend is active but no model is loaded ===== -->
<div class="onb-backdrop" id="llmModal" style="z-index:210;">
  <div class="onb-modal" style="max-width:480px;">
    <h1 style="font-size:18px;margin:0 0 4px;">Load a local model</h1>
    <p class="onb-sub" style="margin-bottom:14px;">A model must be loaded before you can chat locally. It downloads once and runs entirely in your browser — no data leaves your machine.</p>
    <div id="llmModalMemBadge" class="hint" style="margin-bottom:10px;background:var(--bg-3);padding:7px 10px;border-radius:6px;"></div>
    <label>Model</label>
    <select id="llmModalPick" style="width:100%;margin-bottom:4px;"></select>
    <div id="llmModalNote" class="hint" style="margin:4px 0 10px;"></div>
    <label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-bottom:6px;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;">
      <input type="checkbox" id="llmModalWebGpu" style="width:auto;margin:0;" />
      <span>Use WebGPU <span class="hint" style="display:inline;">(experimental — only enable after a successful WASM load)</span></span>
    </label>
    <div id="llmModalWebGpuWarn" class="hint" style="color:var(--warn);margin-bottom:8px;display:none;">WebGPU not available in this browser — WASM will be used.</div>
    <div class="onb-progress" id="llmModalProgress" style="margin-top:12px;">
      <div class="progress"><div class="bar" id="llmModalBar"></div></div>
      <div class="onb-progress-msg" id="llmModalMsg">Loading…</div>
      <button id="llmModalClearCacheBtn" style="display:none;margin-top:10px;font-size:12px;width:100%;" class="ghost">🗑 Clear cached model files & retry</button>
    </div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:16px;gap:8px;">
      <button class="primary" id="llmModalLoadBtn">Load model</button>
      <button class="ghost" id="llmModalSkipBtn">Use OpenAI instead</button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
